observations: Tall orange gas cylinder with a top-mounted valve.
Digital platform scale with a separate display unit on a pillar.
The cylinder has the number '36' printed on the shoulder.
Text on the cylinder includes 'Propane/Propano' and a partially obscured logo.
The scale display has three windows and a numeric keypad.
The cylinder shows surface scratches and some paint loss, typical of use.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows '36' on the shoulder, which may refer to tare weight or a different capacity.

risks.risk: Cylinder is expired or near expiry
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the manufacturing and expiry dates stamped on the cylinder collar or foot ring.
A photo or video of the scale powered on with a known weight on the platform.
A video showing the valve being tested for leaks with soapy water while under pressure.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the stamped markings on the cylinder collar showing the expiry date.
Photo of the scale display powered on and showing a reading.
Photo of the bottom of the cylinder to check for heavy rust or structural damage.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified by type. They can be priced at a worst-case value (scrap for the cylinder and non-functional for the scale) until proof of expiry and operation is provided.
